findings.title: The corrected required residual test is not bound as the final active protected identity

evidence.observation: The revision-5 census correctly records the revised test as Git blob f6fb2b876e91094c2dc721aab39ad025504bec5b; its LF SHA-256 is 5d212bceb65e8e1bad91235ee5febf035fcf24085201722826b8f242a655329e and it expects both active revision IDs.

findings.impact: After C0-a commits the exact nine-row census, the earlier differs-from-HEAD and missing-commit failures are removed, but residual Closeout still fails with repository lightweighting final added-row Git blob mismatch for the required test.
